title: The Weekend - Star Trek The Lost Generation

segments.en: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 您好英语学习者，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: And today we're bringing you another sci-fi lesson for all of those fans out there of Star Trek and Star Wars.
segments.zh: 今天，我们为所有《星际迷航》和《星球大战》的粉丝带来另一堂科幻课。

segments.en: And today we're going to focus on some phrases.
segments.zh: 今天我们将专注于一些短语。

segments.en: We're not going to do any vocabulary today.
segments.zh: 我们今天不会做任何词汇。

segments.en: We're just going to learn some phrases that you'll find relating to science fiction.
segments.zh: 我们将学习一些您会发现与科幻小说有关的短语。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to a dialogue for the first time and we'll come back and look at all these phrases.
segments.zh: 那我们先来听第一遍对话，然后再回来看看所有这些短语。

segments.en: Captain, we are under attack by an unidentified ship.
segments.zh: 船长，我们正遭到一艘不明飞船攻击。

segments.en: We've sustained heavy damages to the engines.
We'll have to attempt to make contact.
segments.zh: 我们得试着和对方取得联系。

segments.en: This is Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the Starship Enterprise.
segments.zh: 我是企业号星舰的让-吕克·皮卡德船长。

segments.en: What is the nature of this attack?
I am Captain Kor of the ship Kortos, your ship attack that will search party.
segments.zh: 我是科尔托斯号的科尔船长。你们的飞船袭击了我们的搜索队。

segments.en: No, you're not doing it right.

segments.zh: 科尔的声音不是那样的。

segments.en: I am Captain Kor of the ship Kortos, your ship.
segments.zh: 我是科尔托斯号的科尔船长。你们的飞船……

segments.en: No, if you can't do an authentic Klingon voice, I'll have to find a more serious Star Trek fan who can actually act, okay?
segments.zh: 不行。要是连像样的克林贡口音都模仿不出来，我就得另找个真正会演的《星际迷航》迷了。

segments.en: But, but, I already bought the Klingon suit and the wig and...
segments.zh: 可、可是，我都买好克林贡人的服装和假发了……

segments.en: All right, very good Star Trek fans.
segments.zh: 好吧，非常好的星际迷航粉丝。

segments.en: Apparently, they were trying to act out one of the famous episodes where the Klingons attack the Enterprise.
segments.zh: 显然，他们想演的是克林贡人攻击企业号的著名剧集之一。

segments.en: I don't know a lot about Star Trek, but I do know a lot about language and we've got some great stuff here that will help you understand sci-fi movies and TV shows in English a little bit better.
segments.zh: 我对《星际迷航》不太了解，但我对语言很了解；我们这里有一些很棒的内容，能帮你更好地理解英语科幻电影和电视剧。

segments.en: So, why don't we go now to Fluency Builder?
segments.zh: 那么，我们现在为什么不去流利表达呢？

segments.en: All right, so the first phrase that we have today on Fluency Builder, unidentified ship.
segments.zh: 好吧，今天我们流利表达的第一个短语是 unidentified ship，不明飞船。

segments.en: If we break it down and look at the first word, unidentified.
segments.zh: 如果我们拆开来看第一个词，unidentified，

segments.en: You don't know which one it is.
Okay, you don't know the identity.
And a ship, I guess that's short for...
So, we're not talking boats here.
segments.zh: 所以，我们不是在这里谈论船。

segments.en: Now, moving on to our second phrase, the Enterprise lost its warp drive.
segments.zh: 现在，继续我们的第二个短语，企业号失去了它的曲速引擎。

segments.en: So, the warp drive of the Enterprise is actually something like an engine that allows it to go faster than the speed of light.
segments.zh: 因此，企业号的曲速引擎实际上就像一种发动机，能让它比光速还快。

segments.en: Well, if we take a look at the word warp, that actually means to bend.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果我们看一下 Warp 这个词，那实际上意味着弯曲。

segments.en: So, like when you warp wood, it bends.
segments.zh: 所以，就像你扭曲木头一样，它会弯曲。

segments.en: You bend wood or you warp metal.
segments.zh: 你弯曲木头或弯曲金属。

segments.en: And well, that's kind of the theory behind it is that they're going so fast that they bend or warp time.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是背后的理论，因为它们的速度如此之快，以至于它们弯曲或扭曲时间。
所以，就是 warp drive，曲速引擎。

segments.en: I think a very sci-fi specific phrase here.
segments.zh: 我认为这里有一个非常科幻的短语。

segments.en: And for our third phrase today, search party.
segments.zh: 我们今天的第三个短语，search party，搜索队。

segments.en: Well, when somebody gets lost, you know, maybe in the woods or something, you send out a search party to find them.
segments.zh: 好吧，当有人迷路时，你知道，也许在树林里什么的，你派出一个搜索队去寻找他们。

segments.en: So, a party would be a group of people.
segments.zh: 所以，party 指的就是一群人。

segments.en: So, that also happens in restaurants, I think, right?
segments.zh: 所以，这也发生在餐馆，我想，对吧？

segments.en: Sometimes you might say how many people in your party.
segments.zh: 有时你可能会说你的队伍中有多少人。

segments.en: So, in the dialogue, we saw that actually these were not real Star Trek characters, but they were just acting.
segments.zh: 所以，在对话中我们看到，他们其实不是真正的《星际迷航》角色，只是在演戏。

segments.en: But it didn't sound quite right, right?
segments.zh: 但这听起来不太对，对吧？

segments.en: He said that his voice is deeper.
We're going to hear an example of what a deep voice sounds like.
segments.zh: 我们来听一个例子，听听低沉的声音是什么样。

segments.en: The one constant through all the years, Ray, has been baseball.
segments.zh: 多年来，雷不变的是棒球。

segments.en: America has rolled by like an army of steamrollers.
segments.zh: 美国像一支压路机大军一样滚动。

segments.en: It's been erased like a blackboard, rebuilt and erased again.
segments.zh: 它像黑板一样被抹去，再次被重建和擦除。

segments.en: Now, because his voice wasn't deep enough, he didn't sound authentic.
segments.zh: 现在，因为他的声音不够低沉，听起来就不地道。

segments.en: So, Marco, is that an authentic Rolex?
segments.zh: 那么，马可，那是真正的劳力士吗？

segments.en: And our last word for today.
segments.zh: 以及我们今天的最后一句话。

segments.en: So, a wig is pretend hair, right?
segments.zh: 所以，假发就是假头发，对吧？

segments.en: So, the hair is not authentic.
We've got some great language here.
segments.zh: 我们这里有一些很棒的语言。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to it one more time, slowed down a little bit, in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们再来听一遍，语速放慢一点。

segments.en: Captain, we're under attack by an unidentified ship.

segments.en: We've sustained heavy damages to the engines.
We'll have to attempt to make contact.
segments.zh: 我们得试着和对方取得联系。

segments.zh: 这是企业号星舰的皮卡德船长。

segments.zh: 我是克劳斯号的科尔船长。

segments.en: Your ship attacked our search party.
segments.zh: 你的船袭击了我们的搜索队。

segments.en: No, you're not doing it right.

segments.en: I am Captain Kor of the ship Clothos.
segments.zh: 我是克劳斯号的科尔船长。

segments.en: If you can't do an authentic Klingon voice, I'll have to find a more serious Star Trek fan who can actually act, okay?
segments.zh: 如果你模仿不出地道的克林贡口音，我就得另找一个真正会演的《星际迷航》迷，好吗？

segments.en: But but, I already bought the Klingon suit and the wig.
segments.zh: 但是，我已经买了克林贡套装和假发。

segments.en: Now it's time for us to take a look at more phrases today in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 现在，我们来看看流利表达里更多的短语。

segments.en: So, we've got some phrases here that you can use together with a number of different words, right?
segments.zh: 所以，我们这里有一些短语，你可以和许多不同的词一起使用，对吧？

segments.en: So, the first one, we heard that data said we're under attack.
segments.zh: 所以，第一个，我们听到 Data 说我们受到了攻击。

segments.en: So, if we're under attack, it means that we are being attacked.
segments.zh: 所以，如果我们受到攻击，这意味着我们正在受到攻击。

segments.en: Someone is shooting guns at you or trying to hurt you or something like that.
segments.zh: 有人向你开枪、想伤害你，或诸如此类。

segments.en: Very popular phrase that you would hear in war movies or something.
segments.zh: 你会在战争片之类的影视里常听到的短语。

segments.en: Now, you can change this by changing the last word.
segments.zh: 现在，您可以通过更改最后一个单词来更改这一点。

segments.en: Under fire, which basically means the same thing.
Yeah, except it, when you're under fire, there are guns involved.
segments.zh: 是的，只不过 under fire 意味着有枪炮参与。
我们受到了火力的打击。

segments.en: Moving on to our second phrase.
segments.zh: 继续我们的第二个短语。
我们遭受了严重的损坏。

segments.en: So, when you sustain something, you receive it or you undergo this thing.
segments.zh: 所以，当你 sustain 某事时，意思是承受或经历这件事。

segments.en: So, usually, it's related to injury or to receiving some type of...
segments.zh: 所以，通常，它与受伤或接受某种类型的...

segments.en: So, why don't we listen to some examples of how we could use sustain in context.
segments.zh: 所以，我们为什么不听一些关于如何在上下文中使用 Sustain 的例子。

segments.en: John had a car accident and sustained a fatal injury.
segments.zh: 约翰发生了车祸，并遭受了致命的伤害。

segments.en: The boxer sustained a severe neck injury in the championship fight.
segments.zh: 这位拳击手在冠军争夺战中颈部严重受伤。

segments.en: Luckily, the warship didn't sustain any serious damage.
segments.zh: 幸运的是，这艘军舰没有受到任何严重的破坏。

segments.en: So, you see, we typically sustain something like an injury or damage that is negative.
segments.zh: 所以，你看，我们通常会承受负面的伤害或损害。

segments.en: And our last phrase for today, what is the nature of this attack?
segments.zh: 我们今天的最后一个短语，what is the nature of this attack？

segments.en: So, basically, he's just asking, why are you doing this?
segments.zh: 所以，基本上，他只是在问，你为什么要这样做？

segments.en: So, again, we have some more examples of how you could use what is the nature of in different situations.
segments.zh: 因此，我们还有更多示例，说明如何在不同场合使用 what is the nature of 这个说法。

segments.en: What is the nature of your visits to the United States?
segments.zh: 您访问美国的性质是什么？

segments.en: What is the nature of the threat against our country?
segments.zh: 对我们国家的威胁的性质是什么？

segments.en: The nature of my visit is personal.
segments.zh: 我访问的性质是个人的。

segments.en: So, a great phrase you can use not only when you're talking sci-fi, but in everyday life.
segments.zh: 所以，一个很棒的短语，你不仅可以在谈论科幻时使用，而且可以在日常生活中使用。
